## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm validate` passes (all frontmatter + section headers valid)
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] Skill follows the format in `docs/SKILL-FORMAT.md`
- [ ] Session Tracking banners are present and correct
- [ ] Mutating skills default to `dry_run: true`
- [ ] CSV filename pattern matches skill name
- [ ] `pnpm build:catalog` and `pnpm build:manifest` run without errors
- [ ] PLAN.md updated if a new skill was added
